공식 ID: newton_divided_difference_formula
역할: definition
LaTeX: p_n(x)=f[x_0]+f[x_0,x_1](x-x_0)+\cdots+f[x_0,\dots,x_n]\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(x-x_k)
CAS 표현: Eq(p_n(x), f_x0 + Sum(f_divided * Product(x - x_k, (k, 0, i-1)), (i, 1, n)))
